summary: Frontend-only visual regression retest for /inscricao.html. Verified the previous rectangular-box artefact around the 'Município de Campo Alegre (AL)' row is fully gone after the CSS fix extending to .blocoPadrao selectors. Screenshot + DOM computed-style probing at multiple points inside the concurso info card confirm no visible border/outline/box-shadow/background on .blocoPadrao / #TopoInformacoes descendants. CAMPO ALEGRE thumbnail on the left remains visible.
critical_code_review_comments: The single .blocoPadrao element (rect 900x36 at y=350) now renders with border-*-width=0px, outline=0px none, box-shadow=none, background=rgba(0,0,0,0) - fix is effective.
The only remaining box-shadow observed in the area belongs to div.Miolo (outer card wrapper), which is intentional and expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified via: (1) cache-busted hard reload of /inscricao.html at 1920x800, (2) full screenshot showing clean layout, (3) elementsFromPoint at (700,302),(900,302),(1100,302),(800,320),(1000,340) - no descendant of .blocoPadrao/#TopoInformacoes shows any visible border/outline/shadow, (4) full sweep of all div.blocoPadrao returned 1 element with all border widths 0px, outline 0 none, shadow none, background transparent. Thumbnail CAMPO ALEGRE visible.
rca of the issue: Previous iterations targeted #TopoInformacoes descendants only; the offending rectangle came from DIV.blocoPadrao which had a background/border. Fix in /app/frontend/public/inscricao.html <style> block now zeros border/outline/box-shadow/background on .blocoPadrao, #TopoInformacoes .blocoPadrao, and #pgInformacoes .blocoPadrao. Verified via computed styles - artefact eliminated.
